_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve surface_pde#2: the Laplace-Beltrami stiffness matrix on the sphere is singular (constants in the kernel) and NEITHER failure mode is loud. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, OCC sphere maxh=0.4 Curve(4), H1 order 3 on Boundaries('.*'), f=6z^2-2 (2026-08-06): with no regulariser both umfpack and sparsecholesky return WITHOUT raising and WITHOUT printing anything, giving |u|_inf = 6.1e+09 / 2.7e+09; with the shipped 1e-8*u*v*ds regulariser max(gfu.vec)=171.5 and the L2 error against the analytic z^2-1/3 is 6.1e+02, while after removing the surface mean it is 2.6e-04 -- which is why the shipped surface_pde_3d template prints max=3387.7 for a field whose true range is [-1/3, 2/3]. Also confirms NGSolve emitted no PETSc-style DIVERGED_BREAKDOWN / DIVERGED_INDEFINITE_PC text.
